verdicts.reason: A: the black panel has shrunk to a small box that holds only a tiny 'MOVIE NIGHT' and two empty divider lines. All the other white copy (film title, tagline, date, address, URL) falls outside the panel onto the busy white doodles and is completely unreadable. B: the same failure, and the order is upside down: the unreadable white copy sits at the top over the illustration, and the 'MOVIE NIGHT' box is stranded below it. A is marginally less bad because its headline at least stays at the top.
